On-Demand Service Reminders

Businesses can trigger push and sms notifications to prompt customers when it's their turn to receive services. This approach minimizes wait times, and enhances customer satisfaction,.

Transparent Queue Management

We provide transparent queue management for customers, enhancing trust and satisfaction. Customers can view their position in real-time via the QR code scanning or manual entry. Additionally, businesses can recall deleted or served customers back into the queue, ensuring fairness and transparency.

Feedback and Rating

We empower customers to share their feedback and rate their experience effortlessly. After being served, customers can share their feedback and provide valuable insights. This enables businesses to gather actionable feedback.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I get started with Q-int?

Simply sign up on our website, and you’ll receive a step-by-step guide to integrate Q-int into your business operations.

What do I need to set up Q-int for my business?

All you need is internet access and a device to display the queue dashboard, such as a tablet or computer

Can Q-int integrate with my existing business systems?

Yes, Q-int is designed to seamlessly integrate with various business platforms and POS systems

How does Q-int handle customer feedback?

Q-int enables direct feedback collection from customers via digital interactions, helping businesses improve service quality.

Is there a trial period for Q-int?

Yes, we offer a 30-day free trial with full access to all features, no credit card required.

What unique features does Q-int offer

Q-int offers virtual queue management, real-time updates for customers, and advanced analytics for business insights

What pricing plans does Q-int offer?

Q-int offers four main pricing plans: Free, Gold, Premium, and Enterprise. Each plan is designed to suit different business needs, from small startups to large corporations, offering a range of features from basic queue management to advanced analytics and customer re-engagement strategies.

Can I upgrade my plan at any time?

Yes, you can upgrade your Q-int plan at any time. Upgrades are immediate, allowing you to access enhanced features and capabilities as soon as your business requirements grow.

Is there a discount for annual subscriptions?

Q-int values long-term partnerships and offers attractive discounts for users who opt for annual subscriptions over monthly billing. Contact us for detailed pricing and discount information.
